properties.name: MEASURED 2026-09-27 on 0.72.0: revising a DATED ChangeEvent without re-sending detected_at returns the `undated` note, although the stored node keeps its date
properties.source: flo2's design, served by reflow2 0.72.0, dev_reflow2 hub session 2026-09-27
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-27 on reflow2 0.72.0, in flo2's design:
1. chg:flo2-moves-to-reflow2-v0-72-0-2026-09-27 was created with detected_at "2026-09-27".
2. It was then revised with add_change_event {id, affected: [...]} alone, to draw its CHANGED edges.
3. The reply's `event.properties` still showed detected_at "2026-09-27", and in the same reply the `undated` note said: "This ChangeEvent carries no `detected_at`, so nothing can place it in time ... Re-send with `detected_at`".

The note appears to read the CALL's arguments rather than the stored node. A revise that omits a field keeps its stored value, and the tool description says so ("omitted fields keep their stored value").

WHY IT MATTERS: the note tells an agent to re-send a date that is already there. Taken at its word, that costs a redundant write. Worse, an agent that trusts it could "correct" a real date to a guessed one.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the same call-vs-stored confusion exists in any other reply note that fires on a missing field during a revise.

UPDATE 2026-09-28 (triage of art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-27): ROOT-CAUSED in fact:root-cause-the-undated-note-reads-the-call-not-the-stored-node-2026-09-28. The note tests `req.detected_at.is_none()`. dev_storyflow reported the same thing twice before this fact was written (2026-09-23 and 2026-09-25). Reproduced again on a 0.72.0 scratch store: the revise reply carried `undated` beside a stored detected_at. Current source is unchanged. PR #604 recorded this fact and changed no source, so it is NOT a fix. The NOT ESTABLISHED line above is answered: other call-vs-stored confusions exist (record_finding defaults, add_verification guard), so this is a class — fact:root-cause-the-revise-contract-is-implemented-per-handler-and-guarded-by-instances-2026-09-28.
